messages:
Asha: Quick heads-up — health pipeline flagged 3 accounts this AM: acme-pay, metrohealth, glance.ai. Health_score < 0.6 + sustained weekly usage drop. Ticket #4521 created. @Sami @Miguel can we pair on enablement outreach? :wave:
Miguel: Which tenant is highest risk? I can do a consult for one this week, but limited bandwidth.
Asha: acme-pay = highest (engaged -> plateau -> drop), metrohealth = onboarding half-done, glance.ai = spike then falloff. Details in ticket: https://redwood/tasks/4521
health-bot: Auto-alert: created case CS-4521, added time-series, triggered high-touch workflow. :robot_face:
Sami: I can take acme-pay and glance.ai. Available Thu/Fri mornings. Proposed play: 1) 30m enablement w/ SE, 2) share tailored runbook + prompt pack, 3) 14-day follow-up with usage checklist.
Jordan: Good. Let's also prep a softened downgrade path in case adoption doesn't recover — limited feature set + price pro-rata. Keep it as last-resort option, documented in the playbook.
Elena: I'll draft the outreach email + calendar invite template. Putting a quick template below — feel free to edit.
Elena: ```
Subject: Quick check-in & 30m plan to boost LLM throughput
Hi {{FirstName}},
We noticed a drop in usage and want to make sure you hit your goals. Would you be open to a 30-minute session with our SE team to review prompts, batching config, and a short action plan? Suggested slots: Thur 10:00, Fri 11:00.
If you'd prefer to pause or move to a smaller plan, we can outline options that keep your data and integrations intact.
Best,
Elena (Redwood CS)
```
Miguel: Nice. Also suggest we run a quick config check: model variants, batching thresholds, KV cache enabled. If we find a perf regression, put it into the runtime bug queue with P1 if customer impact high.
Asha: Action items: Sami — run enablement sessions (due +5 days). Elena — send templates + outreach (today). Miguel — config audit for acme-pay (due +3 days). Jordan — approve temporary downgrade terms if needed. I'll own follow-ups in the ticket and update CS dashboard. :thumbsup:
Jordan: Approving temporary downgrade guardrails. If adoption doesn't improve after 14 days, CS team may offer downgrade + 1 free enablement. Keep legal in the loop.
Sami: Got it. I'll upload session notes to the ticket and add a short checklist so AMs can reuse.
Asha: Great. Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer health board and ping y'all once replies come in. :eyes:
